title: Remote monitoring without the blanket promise

slides.headline: Remote data still needs a priority
slides.body: Not every reading needs immediate transmission. Define what changes a decision.

slides.headline: Design for constrained payloads
slides.body: Send the smallest useful exception message; retain detail locally where appropriate.

slides.headline: Account for the site
slides.body: Sky view, mounting, antenna placement, power and maintenance access affect the design.

slides.headline: Keep the caveat visible
slides.body: A satellite layer extends the design; it does not guarantee continuous availability or delivery.

slides.headline: Define the reporting logic
slides.body: Bring the site, payload and urgency model to a design review.
